decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established prescription portfolio, so its in-house R&D and formulation know-how let it interpret early results and improve the product, and it already has its own page.

The generic antidepressant capsule is distant from the firm's core offer, which weakens its absorptive capacity for it, but own R&D, generic manufacturing know-how and dedicated web presence make retention more likely than withdrawal in the first year.
The combination antihypertensive line with several models builds on the firm's existing formulation expertise and strategy of improved release forms, so it can learn from and refine the product.
The bone and joint supplement builds on the firm's self-care and pharmacy-exclusive offer and fits its strategy, although its mere mention on the website suggests lower prominence.
